deadline.value: UNSW sets closing dates per scholarship round and term; the international round for Term 2 or 3 2027 closed on 14 August 2026.

entry_route.value: Admission needs a UNSW bachelor's with upper second-class honours or a UNSW Masters by Research, or an equivalent the faculty accepts.
entry_route.quote: an appropriate UNSW bachelor degree with upper second-class honours

also.quote: a completed Masters by Research from UNSW with a substantial research component

supervisor.value: You must find a supervisor and hold a pre-admission interview before you lodge the application.
supervisor.quote: Once you have found supervisor, held your interview, developed a research description, and prepared your supporting documents, you are ready to lodge your application

also.quote: Most Faculties require applicants to contact potential supervisors before applying

funding.value: Stipends come through scholarships that are applied for separately, so the page does not promise funding to every admitted student.
funding.quote: We assist postgraduate researchers with a range of prestigious scholarships with annual stipends

toefl_min.value: Science research degrees need TOEFL iBT 90 overall, with at least 23 in writing and 22 in the other sections.
toefl_min.quote: 90 overall (min. 23 in writing, 22 in reading, listening and speaking)

ielts_min.value: Science research degrees need IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with at least 6.0 in each band.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

notes: The chemistry study-area page lists 'Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)' among its research degrees.
